rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday word for a human fingernail.

example.english: I just trimmed a fingernail that had grown too long.
example.traditional: 我啱啱剪短咗一隻太長嘅指甲。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ngaam1 ngaam1 zin2 dyun2 zo2 jat1 zek3 taai3 coeng4 ge3 zi2 gaap3

rows.note: Use this more explicit form when contrasting a fingernail with a toenail.

example.english: The toenail needs medicine, but the fingernail doesn't.
example.traditional: 隻腳趾甲要搽藥，手指甲就唔使。
example.jyutping: zek3 goek3 zi2 gaap3 jiu3 caa4 joek6 sau2 zi2 gaap3 zau6 m4 sai2
